description: This file is a test script for verifying git operations involving submodules and cherry-pick functionality. It sets up repositories, adds files, performs commits, creates branches, and tests conflict ignoring during cherry-pick operations on submodules.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch
methods.description: Switches the submodule to a specified state or branch for testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, with the provided description.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository in a specified directory.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets global configuration variables for git during the test.
